title: Export tree: two_zone_mode 'auto' (the default) turns on a second zone for installs that store no zone key
claim: In the export handed to this seat, every install that stores no zone key and leaves two_zone_mode at its default publishes two_zone_enabled=True and a plan with distinct upper and lower floor trajectories (6 of 6 such plants), while thermal_model.py's own comment and const.py's TWO_ZONE_MODE comment state that 'auto' is the presence rule; a clean git archive of 92d38ecb reads 0 of 6.
mechanism: ThermalParameters.from_config in the export tests `two_zone_mode in (TWO_ZONE_MODE_ON, DEFAULT_TWO_ZONE_MODE)`; DEFAULT_TWO_ZONE_MODE is 'auto', so the presence branch is reached only for unknown strings and every default install is modelled two-zone with the lower floor's default mass and loss. At the baseline SHA the line reads `== TWO_ZONE_MODE_ON`.

evidence.unit: plants with no zone key published two_zone_enabled=True (of 6)
evidence.baseline_sha: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692 as exported to the seat (the export's thermal_model.py differs from the SHA; a clean git archive of the SHA gives 0)
evidence.machine: box B4, 4 vCPU shared container, Python 3.14

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/thermal_model.py:ThermalParameters.from_config (driven through async_setup_entry and _async_update_data; read off the published two_zone_enabled)

perturbation.change: --presence-rule: from_config decides two_zone_mode 'auto' by the presence of a zone key (in memory, classmethod swap)

metric_definition: invented_zone_plants = plants storing no zone key and no two_zone_mode 'on' whose cycle publishes two_zone_enabled=True
phenomenon_property: A plant is modelled, solved and published two-zone only when its configuration says so (a zone key stored or two_zone_mode 'on'); the default 'auto' never adds a zone.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D12/s1/cells.py --quiet (the check 'published two_zone_enabled=True but the cell declares zone=off' lists every cell, 138 in the export, 0 at the clean SHA)

null_control.command: same command; CONTROL two-zone plant and the two 'mode off' plants
null_control.value: control two_zone_enabled=True with 96 split rows on both arms; the two plants with two_zone_mode 'off' publish False on both arms; clean archive of 92d38ecb: invented_zone_plants=0
null_control.note: the effect vanishes at the baseline SHA and under the documented rule

reproduction_steps: run the command at the export root: invented_zone_plants=6
same command at a clean git archive of 92d38ecb: 0
proposed_fix_scope: thermal_model.py ThermalParameters.from_config: 'auto' falls to the presence rule (as at 92d38ecb); establish why the export differs from the baseline SHA before filing
